description: Public-health executive overview with activity, coverage, demographics and disease surveillance. Aggregate data only.

options.content:
# Public health · Executive overview
Diagnosis activity and patient composition in one place. **Use the filters above to explore.** Patient counts alone uses a fixed date range and unit.

panels.title: Diagnosis records
panels.description: Within the selected period and filters. New patients are distinct UHIDs; patient visits are distinct recorded encounter numbers in the diagnosis data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

panels.title: New patients
panels.description: Within the selected period and filters. New patients are distinct UHIDs; patient visits are distinct recorded encounter numbers in the diagnosis data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(uhid_number, '')) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

panels.title: Patient counts
panels.description: Patient visits from the OPD consultation view, 1 Jul–20 Sep 2026, unit 9, excluding the specified test names. Not controlled by dashboard filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(encounter_id) AS value FROM public.getopdconsultatationDepartmentwiseonly WHERE CAST(encounter_date AS date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND unit_id = 9 AND NOT (patientname LIKE '%Demo%' OR patientname LIKE '%Palak Singh%' OR patientname LIKE '%Shubham Yede%')

options.content:
### Activity & encounter status
Daily diagnosis volumes and encounter status follow dashboard filters.

panels.title: Daily activity
panels.description: Zero-filled days. Daily distinct UHIDs must not be summed to obtain period distinct UHIDs.

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp), interval '1 day') AS time), counts AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',created_date) AS time, COUNT(*)::float AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT uhid_number)::float AS patients FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.time, COALESCE(records,0) AS "Diagnosis records", COALESCE(patients,0) AS "Daily new patients (distinct UHIDs)" FROM days LEFT JOIN counts USING(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Provisional encounters
panels.description: Distinct encounter numbers flagged as this diagnosis status within the selected dashboard period and filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(encounter_number, '')) FILTER (WHERE is_provisional = 'Y') AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

panels.title: Final encounters
panels.description: Distinct encounter numbers flagged as this diagnosis status within the selected dashboard period and filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(encounter_number, '')) FILTER (WHERE is_final = 'Y') AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

options.content:
### Where activity is concentrated
Top diagnoses reflect recorded diagnosis volume, not population-adjusted disease rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(diagnosis_desc,''),'Unknown') AS label, COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Records" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 10

options.content:
### Patient & service composition
Demographics show diagnosis-record distribution; a patient can contribute multiple records.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(gender_name,''),'Unknown') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Age · record distribution
panels.description: Numeric ageyear values only; invalid or implausible values appear as Unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN btrim(ageyear) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CASE WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric < 18 THEN '0–17' WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric < 35 THEN '18–34' WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric < 60 THEN '35–59' WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric <= 120 THEN '60+' ELSE 'Unknown' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label,COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(speciality_name,''),'Unknown') AS label,COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

options.content:
### Disease surveillance
Category flags can overlap. Counts across categories should not be added together.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT * FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')) SELECT 'Communicable' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_communicable='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Non-communicable' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_non_communicable='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Notifiable' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_notifiable='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Vector-borne' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vector_borne='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Occupational' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_occupational_notifiable='Y') AS value FROM selected

SELECT date_trunc('day',created_date) AS time,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_communicable='Y')::float AS "Communicable", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_non_communicable='Y')::float AS "Non-communicable", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_notifiable='Y')::float AS "Notifiable", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vector_borne='Y')::float AS "Vector-borne", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_occupational_notifiable='Y')::float AS "Occupational" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

options.content:
### Coverage notes
Missing fields can affect rankings and demographic interpretation. Auto-refresh: **5 minutes**.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(btrim(gender_name),'') IS NULL) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(btrim(diagnosis_desc),'') IS NULL) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')
